ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Estimated 1:5 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity dark-grey and black pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Heterogeneous distribution of high-contrast white circular and elliptical blobs (mottling) across a uniform dark background on both lobes; linear white streaks present on the medial and distal regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central notch with an estimated internal angle of 38 degrees and deep penetration towards the peduncle.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with sharp peaks and valleys (3-12 pixel amplitude) along the entire trailing edge of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trailing edge curve transitioning into sharp, posteriorly-oriented distal tips with high-curvature sweep.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Widespread detection of high-contrast white circular pixel clusters, approximately 2-6 pixels in diameter, scattered across the ventral surface of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct, high-contrast white linear disruptions; three nearly parallel vertical lines on the left lobe and a prominent diagonal streak on the right lobe medial section.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Active barnacle colonization visible as high-intensity, textured protrusions on the distal tips of both fluke lobes; extensive rake mark scarring across both surfaces.
other_distinctive_markers: Lower central portion of the fluke and peduncle transition are partially occluded by a pinniped (seal or sea lion) in the foreground.
